message:
Partial refunds now come out right. `partialRefund` in `src/payments/partial-refund.js` multiplied the amount by the percent (0–100) without dividing by 100. It now computes `payment.amount * percent / 100`, still rounded.

`npm test` passes in full (20 of 20), including the partial-refund tests. I only changed that one file, so nothing outside `src/payments` was touched.
